original_test_intent: Functionally set an approved BMC LAN channel to a selected static configuration and, as a separately approved checkpoint, DHCP, proving readback and reachability while preserving recovery.
original_method: Use protected App 0x0C/0x01 parameter writes for source/address/mask on the verified channel, with complete baseline, one mode per transaction and independent connectivity monitoring.
manual_activity: Owner chooses either static or DHCP and approves values/impact; operator confirms address uniqueness, routes/DHCP and recovery immediately before each transaction.
safety_requirements: Never chain static and DHCP unattended

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies manual gating but exact source bytes still require channel/value validation and transaction controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected App 0x0C/0x01 runner with validated selectors/endianness, full lan print diff and independent recovery monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original fixed values, commands, static/DHCP sequence and 10/5 timing preserved in Master.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select one approved mode, capture full LAN/session state, apply exact validated parameters once, verify from an independent path and read back all fields; treat the other mode and restoration as separately approved actions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents blindly chaining two disruptive modes and replaces unsafe credentials while retaining both functional checkpoints.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A read-only lan print is only evidence and cannot replace either approved write transition.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong channel/address or DHCP failure can strand management or cause duplicate-IP conflict.

project_override_considerations: Vendor API may replace raw commands only with equivalent per-parameter, apply, reachability and rollback coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source hard-codes an unapproved IP/mask, chains static then DHCP without checkpoints or restore, uses -P credentials, clears logs and treats local readback as sufficient proof.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The command and functional transitions are explicit; safe channel/values, recovery and approval are Project readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Separates static and DHCP coverage into individually approved, recoverable checkpoints with external reachability proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a disruptive but well-defined network configuration test. It must retain real writes, yet each transaction can be safely controlled with validated values and recovery, so REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION is correct.
